title: The Informational Role of the Media in Private Lending

scopes.description: Reproduce the full author-documented empirical workflow and the online-appendix analysis of media sentiment with additional public-information controls. The only supplied artifact is an appendix PDF; no executable program or complete workflow is present.

requirements.description: Author-compatible analysis inputs for Table A1 and the referenced main analyses in Tables 3–5, including the media sentiment, loan and outcome data, and additional public-information controls described in the appendix. Exact dataset files, fields, identifiers, periods, construction and delivery route are not specified in the supplied variant.

issues.description: The supplied variant contains only an online appendix PDF; no executable program, entry point, run instructions or complete author-approved manual workflow is supplied.

The appendix describes Table A1 as an extension of main Tables 3–5 and reports models for loan syndication participation, lead share and spread, using 180-day media, press-release, rating and analyst controls. It identifies RavenPack, S&P historical data, DealScan, Moody’s/Fitch and I/B/E/S in variable descriptions, but does not provide the complete inputs, data dictionary, sample construction, transformations, software, run order, or mapping from scripts to outputs. The source labels are clarification leads rather than separately established live raw-source requirements.

actions.description: Obtain the complete author-provided code or approved manual workflow and the compatible analysis-input data specification for the main and supplementary results.
steps: Request the complete executable program set or author-approved manual replacement, with run instructions, software and version requirements, and available execution logs.

Request a data dictionary and sample-construction description for Table A1 and the referenced main Tables 3–5, including loan identifiers, analysis periods, outcome variables, control-variable timing and transformations.

Request the compatible author-prepared analysis files or a permitted route for the required variables; clarify how the appendix’s RavenPack, ratings-agency, DealScan and I/B/E/S references relate to the actual prepared inputs and whether they are embedded in an author dataset.

validation: After complete materials are obtained, inventory the data/programs, verify required fields and historical coverage against the author specification, trace all producers and consumers, and map each named table to a documented entry point.
